title: Health login endpoint returns success for seeded credentials
description: POST /api/auth/health/login with payload {healthId: "1100100100011", password: "Test@12345"} must return HTTP 200, success=true, top-level tokens.access_token and tokens.refresh_token, and metadata fields requestId/timestamp/path/method.

title: Payment webhook callback returns structured diagnostics
description: POST /api/webhooks/payment with payload {event:'payment_intent.succeeded',data:{object:{id:'pi_123456789',amount:1000,currency:'usd'}}} must return HTTP 200 and include requestId, callbackStatus (success|failed), processing(boolean), and when callbackStatus=failed include error object with code and message.
